text:
eva (Docs): Drafting the release note + changelog entry for this week. Includes whatsnew banner, SDK migration note, and 2 known issues (link TTL & reranker alias). Need quick review before I open the PR.
sam (Eng): quick ask: can the banner explicitly call out that Dedicated customers are excluded from hosted routing changes? Helps reduce inbound support.
eva (Docs): good call. Proposed whatsnew banner: "Adaptive routing may fall back to compatible model variants under peak load — lowers cost but can change tail latency. Hosted API only; Dedicated unaffected." ok?
morgan (SDK): looks good. Also we changed the JS streaming helper name last sprint; make sure examples use client.responses.stream() not client.streamResponses().
eva (Docs): adding that and a short migration snippet. morgan can you paste the minimal JS + Py examples to include?
morgan (SDK): paste. JS:
```js
const stream = client.responses.stream({ model: 'rwd-7b', input: 'Summarize the patch' });
for await (const chunk of stream) console.log(chunk.text);
```
Py:
```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
for chunk in client.responses.stream(model='rwd-3b', input='Summarize'):
    print(chunk.text)
```
morgan (SDK): note: JS requires sdk >= 1.4.0 and Python >= 0.9.0. Old helpers are deprecated with warnings.
tara (Support): please add a short troubleshooting checklist for customers who see deprecation warnings: 1) check sdk version; 2) update via pip/npm; 3) restart service. I'll paste it into canned replies.
eva (Docs): added the 3-step checklist under Migration. Also adding a reranker note — sam, I think the old alias rwd-ranker-v1 will be removed next month?
sam (Eng): yes, ENG-2301. We'll keep an alias for 2 weeks, then cut. Add migration tip: switch to rwd-ranker-v2 and re-run index jobs.
eva (Docs): done: "Reranker aliasing may return 404 after 2026-06-15; update to rwd-ranker-v2 and reindex. (ENG-2301)"
tara (Support): another small one: preview docs links in publisher were expiring after 1 hour; public CDN links now default to 14 days but some edge caches still show staging redirects. Any status?
sam (Eng): fixed CDN rule, public TTL = 14d. There's a follow-up ENG-2310 for flaky edge cache invalidations. Workaround: publish stable page or request extended TTL from eng.
eva (Docs): added known issue: "Intermittent staging redirect for legacy anchors and short preview TTLs; workaround: publish stable page or request longer TTL. (ENG-2310)"
release-bot: PR 5011 opened by eva: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5011|view PR> :spiral_note_pad:
tara (Support): thanks — I'll link PR 5011 in the KB and add the migration snippet to canned replies.
morgan (SDK): small nit: the whatsnew banner had both JS and Py examples; consider moving code to a "Code examples" collapsible so banner stays compact.
eva (Docs): good UX suggestion. I'll put snippets in a collapsible section under the whatsnew and keep a one-sentence mention in the banner. Planning to merge in 45 mins unless anyone objects. :thumbsup:
